_note: Vehicles (docs/V4_DESIGN.md section 5). sim/vehicles.gd reads this file. Speeds m/s, charge and fuel in units, wear 0..100 (100 = broken). A rover drives on the rover grid (slope <= 0.6, no crevice, round boulders); a hopper flies hops of up to hop_m metres. Seats from ART-B. build_work: technician work at the depot, like construction.

small_rover.name: Small rover
small_rover.desc: Two seats, small cargo, short range. For work round the base. Crew wear suits.

medium_rover.name: Medium rover
medium_rover.desc: Six seats, a pressurised cabin, large cargo and long range. Carries Outpost Kits and runs routes between bases.

hopper.name: Hopper
hopper.desc: Short flights of up to 400 m over crevices and up to plateaus and peaks. Uses rocket fuel.

satellite.name: Survey satellite
satellite.desc: Built and launched at a launch pad. With an uplink (a powered comms tower) it maps one band of the planet every minute.
